needs.proposedSignature: { op: 'set-level'; to: number } as the effect of a sorcery-speed activated ability with activateOnlyIf { kind: 'self-level-eq', value: N-1 }; a trigger { on: 'became-level'; level: number }; and an ability gate `Ability.atLevel?: number` read by abilitiesOf / computeStaticMods
needs.semantics: CR 716.2a's three halves of a class level bar: the activated ability that raises the level, the 'When this Class becomes level N' trigger, and the 'as long as this Class is level N or greater' gate on the abilities the bar introduces. A level is a designation on the permanent, not a counter (716.2b), so the existing 'level' counter is not a substitute.
